message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the loaded dataset or configuration parameters anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data and tokenizer are loaded from disk and HuggingFace Hub (AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained, datasets.load_from_disk) without any checksum verification, pinned revisions, or authentication checks.
No detected label flipping detection: The code performs no label distribution comparison, validation of label values against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tool usage before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps applied to the training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a checkpoint via a hardcoded path and loads a pretrained model from HuggingFace Hub by name without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard AdamW with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: Only a single accuracy metric is computed, there is no data hashing/signing, no cryptographic isolation of the test set, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path loads data directly from disk via HuggingFace datasets and passes it straight to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation of the input data.

No detected output bounds checks: Logits and predictions are used directly with torch.argmax and metric.add_batch without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or confidence threshold validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a BERT-based sequence classifier (not a generative LLM), and no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, or output content moderation is implemented.
